title: Ast
description: A bundle's syntax tree: each of its files, parsed.

BindInput.description: `"field" -> Slot;`. The slot is as written: `Size`, `Color@3`.

object.description: For `"obj".f(…)`, the quoted receiver; `callee` is then the method.

ChildField.description: One field of a child's one-liner.

Comments.description: The comments around a node, each as written (`// …` or `/* … */`).

after.description: The comment after the node, on its last line.

before.description: The comments on the lines before the node.

end.description: For a block, the comments after its last member, before its `}`.

oneOf.description:
A name: a local, a constant, an external, a renderer property, a member swizzle
(`scene.dt`, `rend0.Atlas.SubDiv`, `v.xyz`); `::name` with `global`.
`ext "name"`: an external whose name is not an identifier.
`f(a, k = b)`, `obj.f(…)`, `"obj".f(…)`, with an optional `: T` result type.

object.description: For `"obj".f(…)`, the quoted receiver; `callee` is then the method.

oneOf.description: `(expr).xyz`: lanes of a value that is not a name.
`call(OBJ, "func", flags, target, slot, RT){ tag: arg, … }`.

File.description: One file of the bundle, or a module it imports.

end_comments.description: The comments after the last item.

library.description:
A module of the library, there to be read. A build reads the library itself, so it is not
printed or built.

name.description:
Its name in the bundle (`code.cfx`, `lib/helpers.cfx`), or a library module's path in its
library (`stdlib/physics.cfx`).

text.description:
A legacy file the tree does not read (`fields.cfx`, `events.cfx`), as written. It has no
items, and is printed as it is.

Generic.description: A type parameter: `T` or `T: vec + float`.

oneOf.description: `key = value;`, a field of the graph node.
`header { … }` (effect.cfx): the bundle's metadata and the effect's own fields.
`attributes { … }` (effect.cfx): the effect's attributes and attribute samplers.
`node H : Class { … }` (effect.cfx): any other object, the objects it owns nested inside.

owner.description: The field of the enclosing node that owns this one; none at the top level.

oneOf.description: `layer NAME { … }` in effect.cfx: a layer's properties, the older place for them.
`layer NAME { … }` (code.cfx): a layer's properties, events and programs.

extends.description: The templates it extends, by name.

result.description: The trailing expression, without a `;`: what the function returns.

KeyRow.description: `t = value [in tangent out tangent]`, one key.

LayerRef.description: A layer as the graph names it.

Member.description: A line, or a block, inside a declaration's braces.

oneOf.description: `Key;`: a flag that is set, or a renderer feature at its default.
`keys N { t = value [in … out …] … }`: a curve's key list.

A child's one-liner: `sampler "Name" : Curve = &sd0 usage 3;`, `spatial …`, `attrib …`,
`attribsampler …`, `payload …`, or an attribute sampler in `attributes`.
A node nested in a `node` block, owned by one of its fields.

owner.description: The field of the enclosing node that owns this one; none at the top level.

oneOf.description: `event NAME [flags N] { payload … }` or `event NAME;` in a layer.

payload.description: The payload's fields; none for `event NAME;`.

oneOf.description: `root [auto] …` in a layer: the payload a newborn receives.
`fields { "Name" : Type; … }` in a layer: the externals its programs share.
`bind HANDLE { "field" -> Slot; … }`: a layer's renderer inputs.
`using { "param" = value; … }` in a declaration or template that extends one.

Need.description: `"Name" [: Type];`, one external a program, or a layer's `fields`, declares.

Param.description:
A parameter: `p: T`, `p: &T` (`by_ref`), `p: const &Renderer` (`const_ref`), with an optional
`= default`.

PayloadField.description: `Name [: Type] [= flags] [kind K];`, one field of an event's payload.

Stmt.description: A statement of a program or a function body.

oneOf.description: `Target = EXPR;`: a store, a local's rebinding, or a lane write (`v.xy = …`).

element_kind.description: `kind K` after an element line of an `emit` block (a statement's `kind` is its tag).

target.description: A dotted name (`Position`, `self.lifeRatio`, `v.xy`), or a quoted one when `quoted`.

oneOf.description: `EXPR;`: a call made for what it does.
`store "NAME" = EXPR;`, the older spelling of a store.

`E.emit(gen) { … }`: an event sent with its elements, each an [`Assign`] of the element's
name (`Color = VectorLinear(prev, cur) kind Generic;`), among `let`s.

call.description:
The head, `E.emit(gen)` or `E.emit(gen, key = N)`; `"E".emit(gen)` for an event whose name
is not an identifier.

oneOf.description:
`L.insert(at) { … }`: the particle put into a spatial layer with its payloads, each an
[`Assign`] of the payload's name (`Position = p;`), among `let`s.

TakesParam.description:
`"param" : Type [= default];`. A default is kept as written: a template's text is merged
before it is read.

Value.description:
A value of a structure file, read without the schema: what a field's type makes of it is the
schema's to say.

oneOf.description: Anything else, as written: an enum word (`Cylinder`, `f32x4`), `2.5.0`, `b64"…"`.
Several values side by side, separated by spaces.
